title: Recover an AGV by removing and adding it, then sending it to the hospital using Go-to so it drops, reinitializes, and picks up a new tote
summary: If an AGV is in a green/ready state but not picking up a task, use the Robot Selection remove-and-add sequence so the tote enters the “question mark” state. Then use the Robot Selection Go-to function to send the AGV to the hospital drop-off location. After you remove the tote at the hospital, the AGV drops, reinitializes, and returns to pick up a new tote. The source also notes that WCS may not reinitialize the AGV if the tote remains in an improper binding state after remove/add; sending to the hospital and removing the tote is the recovery path.
when_to_use: Use when an AGV is not picking up a task and is described as being in a green state (ready to execute something but without a task). The recovery sequence is specifically described as: remove and add the AGV so totes enter the “question mark” state, then use Go-to to send the AGV to the hospital so it can drop, reinitialize, and pick up a new tote.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Identify the AGV that is green but not in a task, perform the remove-and-add sequence, send the AGV to the hospital using Go-to, and remove the tote at the hospital so the AGV can drop and reinitialize.
access_or_tools_needed: Remove and add controls for the AGV (as referenced by the segment)
Map/cell selection for the hospital destination
Ability to remove the tote at the hospital location

system_preconditions: AGV is in the described green state (ready to execute something but not currently in a task).

visual_references.description: Robot Selection Go-to recovery sequence showing: remove/add to get totes into “question mark” state; use Go-to to send to hospital; after tote removal at hospital the AGV drops, reinitializes, and picks up a new tote; includes WCS reinitialization/binding note.

steps.title: Identify the AGV that is in the documented green state but not picking up a task
steps.purpose: Confirm you are recovering the correct AGV: the source describes the target condition as green/ready but not in a task.
steps.instruction: On the OptiSweep Robot Selection screen, select the AGV and verify it is in the described green state (robot not in a task).
steps.expected_result: The selected AGV shows the described “Green: robot not in a task” condition, indicating it is ready to execute something but currently has no task.
steps.healthy_condition: Robot status for the selected AGV is green (not in a task).
steps.failure_condition: The selected AGV is not in the described green/not-in-task state (e.g., it is in task/searching for label or shows a fault/low battery).

actions.label: Select AGV on Robot Selection screen

screens_or_images.what_to_look_at: Robot status color legend: Green = robot not in a task; also use the robot selection details panel to confirm you selected the correct robot ID/location.

steps.title: Remove and add the AGV so the totes enter the “question mark” state
steps.purpose: Force the recovery sequence so the tote binding state changes as described by the source (totes now in the “question mark state”).
steps.instruction: Perform the source-described remove-and-add action for the selected AGV so the totes enter the “question mark” state.
steps.expected_result: After remove/add, the tote associated with the AGV shows a “?” (question mark) before it, indicating the robot was removed but the tote has not (as described by the source).
steps.healthy_condition: Tote display shows a “?” before it for the AGV’s tote section (question mark state).
steps.failure_condition: Tote does not show the “?” state after remove/add, or the AGV does not transition into the described recovery-ready condition for the next Go-to step.

steps.title: Use Go-to to send the AGV to the hospital drop-off location
steps.purpose: Move the AGV to the hospital so you can drop the tote there and trigger the described drop/reinitialize/pickup behavior.
steps.instruction: On the OptiSweep Robot Selection screen, use the Go-to function: select the AGV, select Go to, select the hospital destination square by clicking on the map/cell, then select Confirm.
steps.expected_result: The Go-to action is confirmed for the selected AGV with a hospital destination selected on the map, so the AGV navigates to the hospital drop-off area.
steps.healthy_condition: Go-to target is set to the hospital location and the AGV is sent there (per the source’s described flow).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot select/confirm a hospital destination square, or the AGV does not move to the hospital after Go-to confirmation.

actions.label: Select destination square on map
actions.exact_action: Select which square you want the AGV to go to

screens_or_images.what_to_look_at: Go-to UI steps: Select AGV -> Select Go to -> Select which square -> Select Confirm.

steps.title: At the hospital, remove the tote from the AGV
steps.purpose: Trigger the described WCS reinitialization condition by removing the tote at the hospital.
steps.instruction: Once the AGV arrives at the hospital, remove the tote from the AGV at the hospital location.
steps.expected_result: The tote is removed from the AGV at the hospital.
steps.healthy_condition: Tote is no longer on the AGV after the hospital drop-off action.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot remove the tote at the hospital, or the tote remains on the AGV.

actions.label: Remove tote at hospital
actions.exact_action: remove the tote from at the hospital

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if you cannot get the tote removed at the hospital.

steps.title: Observe the AGV: it should drop, reinitialize, and return to pick up a new tote
steps.purpose: Verify the recovery succeeded: the AGV drops, reinitializes, and picks up a new tote after hospital tote removal.
steps.instruction: After tote removal at the hospital, observe the AGV behavior/state until it drops, reinitializes, and comes back to pick up a new tote.
steps.expected_result: The AGV drops, reinitializes, and returns to pick up a new tote.
steps.healthy_condition: AGV completes the described drop/reinitialize cycle and then is ready to pick up a new tote.
steps.failure_condition: AGV does not reinitialize after tote removal.
stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if the AGV does not drop/reinitialize after tote removal.

success_criteria: After sending to the hospital and removing the tote there, the AGV drops, reinitializes, and returns to pick up a new tote.
healthy_conditions: AGV shows the described green/not-in-task state when it is ready but not currently executing a task (before recovery).
After hospital tote removal, the AGV performs the described drop and reinitialization behavior and then picks up a new tote.
failure_conditions: WCS does not reinitialize the AGV after remove/add because the tote remains in an improper binding state.
You cannot remove the tote at the hospital.
AGV does not drop/reinitialize after tote removal.
escalation_guidance: If you cannot get the tote removed at the hospital, escalate.
If the AGV does not drop/reinitialize after tote removal, escalate.

If remove/add alone does not lead to proper reinitialization, follow the source’s hospital-based recovery path (hospital drop-off + tote removal) because WCS will not reinitialize until the tote is removed and added again.
